metric_definitions.citation: Final answer citations; an abstention has no citations and scores zero.
metric_definitions.agent_retrieval: Ranked hits in agent retrieve steps, independently of its answer.
metric_definitions.final_attempt: Last retrieval passed to evidence grading; not the best attempt.
metric_definitions.any_attempt: Union coverage across retries; NOT Recall@K of a single ranked search.
metric_definitions.precision_at_k: Relevant returned hits divided by K, including unfilled slots as misses.
metric_definitions.relevance: Document labels only; a document match does not prove the right facts were retrieved.
metric_definitions.legacy_retrieval: Deprecated citation-based fields retained unchanged for compatibility.
